skirmish.module.nametag_hp.name: Nametag HP
skirmish.module.nametag_hp.description: Other players' health over their heads. Skirmish style: a plate like the client's with face, nick, HP, a bar with a damage trail and absorption, shown only in plain line of sight, never through blocks. Vanilla style: a line next to the vanilla nametag.
Always, only while you are in PvP (combat tag or an active fight), or only for players you are fighting
skirmish.module.nametag_hp.setting.units: Health points (20 = full) or hearts (10 = full, like the health bar)
skirmish.module.nametag_hp.setting.posit: A line above the nick, below it, or on the same line after the nick
skirmish.module.nametag_hp.setting.bar.t: A small health bar next to the number
skirmish.module.nametag_hp.setting.style: A Skirmish plate instead of the nametag, or a vanilla line next to it
skirmish.module.nametag_hp.setting.scale: Plate size up close; it shrinks with distance
Skin head on the left of the plate
skirmish.module.nametag_hp.setting.invis: Show HP of invisible players (HolyWorld's rules allow HP indicators); the plate is translucent and marked with a crossed eye
